answer: Every payout claim must be anchored to a chain of stranger-verified jobs, one link per epoch, and the chain erodes like karst limestone: each epoch one link dissolves unless refreshed by fresh stranger work, so an operator must keep every clone's chain alive at full cost. The wharf admits claims only during a short tide window, one claim per anchor chain per window, and chains tracing to one funding source fuse into a single anchor: n clones share one berth and one payout while each paid its own eroding chain. Cloning multiplies maintenance cost while revenue stays capped at one tide.
